our_interpretation: Assess actual calendar-year 2026 expenditure, not whether a forecast of that amount existed.
The nearby reference to 2003–2017 supplies the Amazon comparison period. Use Amazon's consolidated capital expenditure over those years, not an invented AWS-only allocation.
The linked Goldman Sachs analysis indicates an estimated AI-infrastructure basis, but does not supply a named big-tech company cohort matching the sentence.
Treat $765 billion as a rounded figure. Any tolerance and company membership must be fixed before grading completed spending.
criteria.support_condition: Actual 2026 spending for a consistently defined cohort and expenditure measure is approximately $765 billion and exceeds ten times comparable Amazon capital expenditure over 2003–2017.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable completed-year spending materially differs from $765 billion, or the ratio to the verified Amazon baseline is ten or less.
